title: Global scalar extension of one augmented localization factor
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site, O a commutative ring sheaf, A its ring of global sections, F the actual scalar-extension functor [def-weil-pbc-global-section-scalar-extension], and s a global section of O. Write t for the corresponding constant section of the one-point A ring sheaf [lem-weil-pbc-ring-tensor-cech-coordinates]. There is an isomorphism from the actual two-term complex [O to O[1/s]] to F of [A to A[1/t]] [def-weil-pbc-ringed-extended-cech]. Composing its hom with the fixed scalar-extended augmentation equals the existing projection to O[0]. No regularity or nonvanishing hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Transpose the fixed unit morphism through the sheafification and presheaf-pullback adjunctions. Its transpose evaluates global sections. Evaluation respects multiplication by s, so F(scalar_t) followed by this unit equals this unit followed by scalar_s. This calculation is proved directly from the definitions.

The normalized monoidal structure makes the fixed unit an isomorphism. Use it at every stage to identify the two scalar multiplication sequences after applying F. F preserves their colimits. The already proved localization module cocones in RingedKoszulFactorColimit therefore induce an isomorphism F(A[1/t]) to O[1/s]. The stage-zero leg has denominator s; precomposing with the scalar transition gives the localization unit by the successor-fraction and zero-fraction identities. Thus the induced isomorphism commutes with the specified localization-unit arrow, also for zero sections.

Apply the already proved generic complexIso and factorArrow comparison from RingedLocalizationFactorRestriction to this square. The degree-zero component is the fixed unit, the degree-one component is the colimit isomorphism, and all other components identify zero objects. Reverse the resulting complex isomorphism. Its arrow commutativity equation and cancellation of the isomorphism give precisely the required augmentation equation.

theorem ringFamilyGlobalExtension_localization_factor
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    (s : (O.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections) :
    ∃ e : ringedLocalizationTwoTerm O s ≅ ringFamilyGlobalExtensionComplex O
        (ringedLocalizationTwoTerm (CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf (ringFamilyGlobalRing O))
          (ringTensorCechSection (ringFamilyGlobalRing O) s)),
      e.hom ≫ ringFamilyGlobalExtensionAugmentation O
        (ringedLocalizationTwoTermAugmentation
          (CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf (ringFamilyGlobalRing O))
          (ringTensorCechSection (ringFamilyGlobalRing O) s)) =
        ringedLocalizationTwoTermAugmentation O s
